title: Architecting India’s anime and manga ecosystem
description: The ancient Japanese art of manga has a vibrant subculture in India. India’s is no longer just an emerging demographic for this art; with an estimated 118 million active viewers across platforms, India is now the second-largest anime viewership market globally, trailing only behind China. What it lacks is original production frameworks to become a genuine and lucrative IP generator. The post Architecting India’s anime and manga ecosystem appeared first on Gateway House.
